description: Lists the calling account's own followers, newest first. status="requested" lists the follow requests it has not accepted yet. Only the caller's own relations are readable; reading somebody else's followers is not offered by this API.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's `nextCursor`. Replay it verbatim.

status.description: "accepted" (default) for established follows, "requested" for pending requests. Closed list: any other value is refused, the two states never mix.

name: jj_list_followers
title: List the accounts that follow me
